summary: Quick start guide for the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder (item 57812) covering the six-step setup and wire feed process for flux core or MIG welding.
text_content:
VULCAN OMNIPRO 220 QUICK START GUIDE 57812

1 Connect cables as needed for flux wire welding - see back of guide.

Wingnut
Spacer
Spindle
2 lb Wire Spool
Brake Pad
Welder
2 lb Spool Loading
Adapter and knob required for 10-12 lb spool

Feed Mechanism
feed guides
welding wire
Wire Spool

2 Install wire spool. Insert wire through both feed guides and clamp it into feed mechanism. See manual if changing wire size or using solid wire.

WARNING
To prevent serious injury, read manual warnings and instructions before use.

2"
Contact Tip
Nozzle

3 Take off nozzle and tip, plug selected cord into welder and into wall, turn welder on, and press cold wire feed switch until wire comes out.

WARNING
To prevent fire and serious injury, keep torch and wire clear of grounded objects while welder plugged in.

clockwise

4 Incrementally tighten wire feed tension knob clockwise until wire will bend from feed tension at 2"-3".

wood block
2"-3"

5 Unplug welder and replace nozzle and tip.

6 Hold gun clear of workpiece, then plug in welder, turn it on, and set weld thickness and other settings.

HOLD GUN CLEAR

BASIC WELDING INSTRUCTIONS AND WELDING TIPS ARE IN MANUAL.

key_facts: Product is the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder
Standard spool size for direct loading is 2 lb
An adapter and knob are required to use a 10-12 lb spool
Wire must be inserted through both feed guides before clamping into the feed mechanism
The nozzle and contact tip must be removed before feeding wire in Step 3
Cold wire feed switch is pressed until wire comes out of the gun
Wire feed tension knob is tightened clockwise
Correct wire feed tension is achieved when wire bends at 2 to 3 inches from feed tension
A wood block is used to test wire bend distance of 2"-3"
The welder must be unplugged before replacing nozzle and tip (Step 5)
Gun must be held clear of workpiece before plugging in the welder (Step 6)
See manual for instructions when changing wire size or using solid wire
See back of guide for cable connections for flux wire welding
Keep torch and wire clear of grounded objects while welder is plugged in to prevent fire and serious injury
Basic welding instructions and welding tips are in the manual
